notes: Cash-basis county; all funds governmental, no business-type funds (business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from Exhibit D (p4) Total Governmental Funds column. Exhibit D 'Taxes' 2,944,066 split into property tax 2,751,139 (General Fund, Schedule 1 p5) and inheritance tax 192,927 (Inheritance Tax Fund, Schedule 3 p11); these sum to the printed line. Exhibit D 'Intergovernmental' 1,643,571 split into motor vehicle tax 156,593 and intergovernmental/state aid 1,486,978: Exhibit B (p2) reclassifies the same receipts and shows motor vehicle taxes 156,593 as a general receipt; Intergovernmental = Road state 1,053,004 + state sources 433,974 + motor vehicle taxes 156,593. In detail, the General Fund 'State' 440,864 (Schedule 1) holds the motor vehicle taxes (284,271 state aid + 156,593) but is kept as printed (broad group, review). Noxious Weed (Public Works in the report) is recorded as natural resources/conservation in detail. Transfers: Exhibit D transfers in 1,315,835 = out 1,315,835 (balanced). Cross-check: General Fund out 1,115,835 = Road in 1,074,841 + Building and Land Improvement 12,159 + Reappraisal 28,835; General Fund in 200,000 = Inheritance Tax Fund out 200,000. Transfers are not inside General Fund spending lines (Schedule 1 total disbursements 3,063,648 equals Exhibit D). Roll-forward: 3,557,656 + 5,437,754 - 5,548,718 = 3,446,692 (reconciles). Detail: Schedules 1-4 (budget-to-actual) used; Schedule 5 (p15 combining nonmajor) not itemized to avoid double counting Schedule 4 (it ties to same totals; Schedule 4 receipts total 211,509 includes transfers in 40,994, excluding them gives 170,515). For nonmajor funds the individual fund is in 'department' and fund = 'Nonmajor special revenue funds' so items tie to detail_totals. 'Operating expenses' (object) mapped to professional/contract services; 'Personnel services' to salaries and wages; 'Capital outlay' to equipment purchases (construction/infrastructure for road funds, land and buildings for Building and Land Improvement Fund). Blank Actual cells in schedules recorded as 0. 'Local' receipts on General and Road schedules recorded as charges for services/fees (matches Exhibit B/D) with review. Road Fund 'Debt service' 64,370 not split principal/interest. Page map (trimmed): p1 Exh A, p2 Exh B, p3 Exh C, p4 Exh D, p5-9 Sched 1, p10 Sched 2, p11 Sched 3, p12-14 Sched 4, p15 Sched 5.
